name: Permission Scope Enforcement
description: Enforces machine-readable permission boundaries per agent. Every action evaluated against declared scope.
threat_addressed: Agents that exceed their authorized scope can access data, invoke tools, or take actions they were never approved for. More critically, agents can construct exfiltration trajectories through sequences of individually authorized actions.
enforcement_mechanism: Machine-readable scope definition per agent specifying authorized tools, data sources, and action types. Enforcement operates at two levels: per-action (each call checked against scope) and per-trajectory (cumulative action sequences evaluated against policy). Out-of-scope actions are blocked.

security_outcome.pass: Scope definitions exist for all agents. Both per-action and per-trajectory enforcement active. No privilege escalation pathways.

display_detail: Enforces permission boundaries for each agent action. Checks tool allowlists, rate limits, and destination restrictions.
remediation_hint_template: Action exceeded declared permission scope. Review security.tools and security.scope in ancilis.yaml. To allow this tool, add it to security.tools.allowed.
